text: French Quarter (White Town) is a celebrated destination in Puducherry, Puducherry, renowned for its heritage, colonial, architecture. Located in the historic and scenic region of Puducherry, it holds deep cultural, geographical, and architectural significance. Visitors explore this site to experience the authentic traditions, local atmosphere, and scenic beauty of Puducherry. The best time to plan a visit is generally October to March (pleasant weather, ideal for heritage monuments, wildlife, and cultural walks). Regional cuisines and seasonal festivals enrich the journey.
